title: Elon Musk says xAI "was not built right first time around, so is being rebuilt from the foundations up" (Fred Lambert/Electrek)
summary: Fred Lambert / Electrek: Elon Musk says xAI “was not built right first time around, so is being rebuilt from the foundations up” — Elon Musk admitted today that xAI, his artificial intelligence venture, “was not built right first time around” and “is being rebuilt from the foundations up.”
contentText:
Fred Lambert / Electrek :

Elon Musk says xAI “was not built right first time around, so is being rebuilt from the foundations up”   —  Elon Musk admitted today that xAI, his artificial intelligence venture, “was not built right first time around” and “is being rebuilt from the foundations up.”
